items.source: Atomically returns and removes the first/last element (head/tail depending on the from argument) of the list stored at sourceKey, and pushes the element at the first/last element (head/tail depending on the to argument) of the list stored at destinationKey.
items.translation: 原子性地返回并移除存储在 `sourceKey` 中的列表的第一个/最后一个元素（取决于 `from` 参数是 head/tail），并将存储在 `destinationKey` 中的列表的第一个/最后一个元素（取决于 `to` 参数是 head/tail）推入该列表。

items.source: timeout - maximal duration to wait until an entry in the list at key is available. Must be either Duration.ZERO or greater 1 second, must not be null. A timeout of zero can be used to wait indefinitely. Durations between zero and one second are not supported. Durations are expected to be in whole seconds so only the seconds field is used - the other fields (e.g. nanos) are ignored.
items.translation: timeout - 等待 key 对应的列表项可用的最大时长。该值必须为 Duration.ZERO 或大于 1 秒的时长，且不能为 null。零超时可用于无限期等待。不支持介于零和一秒之间的时长。时长预期以整秒为单位，因此仅使用秒字段——其他字段（例如纳秒）将被忽略。

items.source: a Flux containing the elements removed from the Redis list.
items.translation: 一个包含从 Redis 列表中移除的元素的Flux。

items.translation: <pivot> - 不能为 null。

items.source: Streams of methods returning Mono<K> or Flux<M> are terminated with InvalidDataAccessApiUsageException when RedisElementReader.read(ByteBuffer) returns null for a particular element as Reactive Streams prohibit the usage of null values.
items.translation: 返回 Mono<K> 或 Flux<M> 的方法流会在以下情况终止：当 RedisElementReader.read(ByteBuffer) 针对某个元素返回 null 时，会抛出 InvalidDataAccessApiUsageException，因为响应式流禁止使用 null 值。
